description: Ask Rosetta how a source schema maps onto a canonical one: for each source field the target field, the transform, a confidence and where the mapping came from, with a plan confidence and tier. Pass source_schema (an id and its fields, each a path and type) and canonical_schema (the id of a built-in schema from list_canonical_schemas, or a whole schema). A plan below the confidence bar is queued for review and the answer says so; list_rosetta_review shows the queue. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

canonical_schema.description: The id of a built-in schema (see list_canonical_schemas) or a whole schema with an id and fields.

enum.description: The values the field may take.

path.description: The dot path of the field.

required.description: Whether the schema requires the field.

type.description: The field type, for example string, number or boolean.

id.description: A stable id for the schema.

source_schema.description: The source: an id for it and its fields.

enum.description: The values the field may take.

path.description: The dot path of the field.

required.description: Whether the schema requires the field.

type.description: The field type, for example string, number or boolean.

id.description: A stable id for the source.

name: plan_rosetta_mapping
